Party game for 3 to 15 players

One of you is lying.

Everyone gets the same secret word except one person, who has to fake it.

IMPOSTER
Word sit down
Tag outside

Two ways to play

WordSit down. Find who doesn't know the word. TagGo outside. Imposters tag, crew vote them out.

How a round goes

  1. 1LookPass the box. Everyone sees their card in secret.
  2. 2ClueOne word each about the secret word.
  3. 3VotePoint at once on three. Most votes is out.
  4. 4RevealSee the word and who was lying.
